goal: Differentiate Provider availability from requirements-planning request sensitivity, bound repeated pre-header failures, and resume the official external-executor E2E only when the probes pass.
acceptance_criteria: Tiny and structured probes use the same endpoint, method, model, TLS policy, and credential resolver as requirements planning and persist only redacted metrics and hashes.
A failed tiny probe short-circuits structured and real planning requests; a failed structured probe short-circuits real planning.
Two consecutive same-class pre-header transport timeouts stop the production retry loop, while response-header retryable HTTP remains bounded to three attempts.
Requirements-planning request bytes, hashes, prompt sizes, estimated tokens, and header/body timing are recorded without prompt contents or secrets.
Payload reduction is permitted only if tiny and structured probes pass while the measured real request fails and exceeds the bounded planning-context policy.
No new Provider route, Agent, scheduler, executor type, lifecycle stage, or authority is introduced.

quality_metrics.measure: probe/result classifications with endpoint and payload comparability
quality_metrics.method: mocked differential tests plus one ordered live probe sequence
five-failure fixture and live phase log

quality_metrics.measure: new agents, schedulers, executor types, formal stages, or authorities
quality_metrics.method: kernel contract and architecture regression tests

prevention: Measure tiny, structured, and real request behavior before changing payload or timeout
assurance: Cover probe short-circuiting, retry phase distinction, request identity, metrics privacy, and payload measurement
control: Run deterministic tests before the ordered live probes and only resume the full E2E after A and B pass
improvement: Stop low-information repeated pre-header retries while preserving bounded HTTP response retries

interface_expectations: requirements planning remains on the reviewed Provider route and existing parsing/schema admission path
probe and request metrics are support_diagnostics_only with NOT_EVALUATED formal status
raw goals and explicit constraints are never removed by diagnostics
External Discovery, trust, trial, packaging, delivery, and publication authorities remain unchanged

feedback: Tiny and structured live probes returned headers in 8.407 and 8.656 seconds, proving the Provider baseline and structured method were available.
Two identical 7,953-byte real planning requests timed out before headers and the new retry policy stopped without attempts three through five.
Payload reduction was correctly rejected because the measured request was only about 1,172 estimated input tokens.

worked: Ordered same-route probes separated baseline availability from real-request transport behavior without exposing prompts or credentials.
did_not_work: The upstream Provider still returned no response headers for the real requirements-planning request.
experiments: Retain two-attempt pre-header fail-fast behavior and compare future live evidence before considering any payload change.
